title: Emod reduction round
statement: A reduction round decrements `Count` by one, using truncated subtraction on natural numbers. It then subtracts the product of `M` and the sum of `Free` and the updated `Count` from `Rest` if that product is at most `Rest`; otherwise it leaves `Rest` unchanged.
caveat: The payload omits the definitions of the Emod variables and arithmetic-expression notation, so their intended meanings are inferred from their names and use.
